bindPolicy.leftRightRule: Positive-Y limbs use .L groups and negative-Y limbs use .R groups; cross-side influences are removed before normalization.
bindPolicy.jawRule: Jaw overrides are restricted to the head volume so front paws cannot inherit jaw motion.
bindPolicy.morphologyRule: The canonical quadruped armature is calibrated independently to each source mesh bounds.
bindPolicy.ravagerTailRule: The tail chain follows the Ravager's lateral hook to prevent the tail fin from inheriting rear-leg weights.
bindPolicy.idleTailRule: Idle and CombatIdle sweep the full tail chain gently from side to side without crossing the hind legs.

clips.name: Idle
clips.purpose: rest breathing with a visible side-to-side tail sweep

clips.name: CombatIdle
clips.purpose: alert combat-ready posture with restrained head tracking and tail motion

clips.name: SwordSlashOutward
clips.purpose: runtime-compatible alias of BiteAttack until creature-specific motion routing lands

clips.name: TailWhip
clips.purpose: all tiers; Oathbound and Ravager gain longer effective reach from their longer source tails

clips.name: SpitAttack
clips.purpose: windup, jaw release, and recoil for the poison ranged attack; the projectile and poison VFX spawn from the mouth in the runtime

variants.cleanup: Removed two small disconnected source islands and calibrated a curved tail chain before binding.

checks: front and rear limbs move independently on all four variants
diagonal walk pairs alternate without joined-leg deformation

Ravager tail fin remains continuous through idle, walk, tail-whip, and death
Idle frames 30 and 90 place the tail on visibly opposite sides without intersecting the hind legs
CombatIdle remains loop-safe and preserves clear four-foot combat posture
Oathbound and Ravager SpitAttack poses provide readable windup, open-jaw release, and recovery without mesh pulls
bite, claw, tail-whip, hit, and death poses remain skinned without mesh explosions
remainingRuntimePolish: validate foot contact, root motion, and playback timing in the Three.js runtime
bind the poison projectile and poison VFX spawn to the upper-tier mouth socket at SpitAttack release
replace the temporary SwordSlashOutward alias when creature-specific motion routing lands

processPolicy: All durable rigs, exports, reopen audits, and visual checks were run sequentially with one headless Blender 4.5 LTS process at a time.
